name: odometer
title: Odometer
description: A number whose digits roll to their new value.
use: A figure that changes while it is read, where seeing it move says something: a count going up, a total after a choice, a price as a plan changes, the seconds of a countdown. Write the number once as text in odometer-value, which assistive technology reads, and draw it in odometer-figures, aria-hidden, with one odometer-digit per digit and its numeral in --digit. It takes the type of the place it stands in, so it can be a stat's figure, a heading or a word in a sentence.

instead.when: The figure is read once and does not change while the page is open
It is the time left until something, in days, hours, minutes and seconds
It is a value the reader picks by turning a column

platform.feature: A registered custom property (@property) that eases from one numeral to the next
platform.fallback: The numeral changes in place, with no roll

platform.feature: mod(), which shows a --digit past 9 or below 0 modulo ten
platform.fallback: --digit is drawn as written: keep it between 0 and 9, and a change from 9 to 0 rolls back through the column

platform.feature: sibling-index(), for a small delay from one digit to the next
Alternative text for generated content, content: '…' / ''
platform.fallback: Nothing: the column is in odometer-figures, which is aria-hidden

classes.name: odometer
classes.description: The number, in the type of the place it stands in, with tabular figures. It has no surface and no size of its own

classes.name: odometer-value
classes.description: The number as text, clipped out of sight: what assistive technology reads, find in page finds and a copy takes

classes.name: odometer-figures
classes.description: The number as drawn, hidden from assistive technology: digits and, as plain text between them, the marks that stand still, such as a comma, a point, a currency or a unit

classes.name: odometer-digit
classes.description: One digit: an empty element, a window one line tall onto a column of numerals that stands at --digit and rolls when it changes

properties.name: --digit
properties.description: The numeral, from 0 to 9. A value past 9 or below 0 is shown modulo ten, so counting on from 9 to 10 rolls one step to 0. The stylesheet reads 0 when it is not set

properties.name: --odometer-duration
properties.description: How long a digit takes to roll to its new numeral

properties.name: --odometer-stagger
properties.description: How much later each digit sets off than the one before it
